system:
You answer questions about company SEC filings (10-K and 10-Q) using ONLY the passages provided.
Each passage starts with a header line naming the company, form, fiscal year, period end, doc id and page number. A passage is a piece of one page; a table cut across passages repeats its title and column headings.
Read the numbers you need from the passages and do any arithmetic yourself.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"answer": short answer as a string,
 "value": the answer as a number, a string, a list of company names, or null,
 "unit": one of "USD", "ratio", "shares", "count", "text", "company", "USD/share", "none",
 "abstain": true or false,
 "facts_used": [{"doc": doc id from the page header, "page": page number from the header,
                 "value": the number as a plain number in full units, "label": the line item}]}

Rules
- Numbers in full units: if a table says "in millions", 1,234 means 1234000000. No commas, no symbols.
- Ratios, margins, growth rates and percentages as fractions: 12.5% is 0.125, unit "ratio".
- Per-share amounts: unit "USD/share", value in dollars per share.
- Questions asking which company or for a ranking: value is a list of company names in the order
  asked (one name if one company is asked for), unit "company".
- Names, places and other words: value is a string, unit "text".
- If the passages do not contain what is needed to answer, set "abstain": true and "value": null.
  Do not guess and do not use outside knowledge.
- facts_used lists every number from the passages that you used, with its doc id and page.

Summary Description of Chevron
Chevron Corporation1, a Delaware corporation, manages its investments in subsidiaries and affiliates and provides administrative, financial, management and
technology support to U.S. and international subsidiaries that engage in integrated energy and chemicals operations. Upstream operations consist primarily of
exploring for, developing, producing and transporting crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation and regasification associated with liquefied
natural gas; transporting crude oil by major international oil export pipelines; transporting, storage and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and a
gas-to-liquids plant. Downstream operations consist primarily of refining crude oil into petroleum products; marketing of crude oil, refined products and
lubricants; manufacturing and marketing of renewable fuels; transporting crude oil and refined products by pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment and rail car;
and manufacturing and marketing of commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses and fuel and lubricant additives.

Upstream operations consist primarily of exploring for, developing, producing and transporting crude oil and natural gas; liquefaction, transportation and
regasification associated with LNG; transporting crude oil by major international oil export pipelines; processing, transporting, storage and marketing of natural
gas; carbon capture and storage; and a gas-to-liquids plant. Downstream operations consist primarily of refining of crude oil into petroleum products; marketing of
crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufacturing and marketing of renewable fuels; transporting of crude oil and refined products by pipeline, marine
vessel, motor equipment and rail car; and manufacturing and marketing of commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives.
“All Other” activities of the company include worldwide cash management and debt financing activities, corporate administrative functions, insurance operations,
real estate activities, and technology activities.
